name: Magnetic Flux Density
description: Calculates magnetic flux density (B) using permeability (μ) and magnetic field strength (H).

name: Magnetic Flux
description: Calculates magnetic flux (Φ_B) using magnetic flux density (B), elemental surface area (A), and the angle between the magnetic field and area vector (θ).

name: Faraday's Law
description: Calculates the magnitude of induced emf (E) using the number of turns in the wire loop (N) and the rate of change of magnetic flux (dΦ_B / dt).

name: Efficiency of a Transformer
description: Calculates the efficiency of a transformer as the ratio of output power to input power.
